activities.name: raw_process_movement
activities.description:
This notebook activity orchestrates file movement from the Ingest folder to the Process Folder and ensures the presence of all file names in the Process folder.
Please note that there should not be more than one instance of this notebook running as this will cause inconsistent results.

activities.name: imaging_patch_bronze_ingestion
activities.description:
This notebook activity process the PATCH files and ingest the metadata into the Delta table `ImagingDicom`. It reads the NDJSON files from the source path, extracts the metadata, and writes it to the Delta table.
Please note that there should not be more than one instance of this notebook running as this will cause inconsistent results.

activities.name: imaging_bronze_silver_metastore_transformation
activities.description:
The transformation notebook activity helps transform the extracted metadata (DICOM tags) into the silver ImagingMetastore table.
Please note that there should not be more than one instance of this notebook running as this will cause inconsistent results.

activities.name: imaging_dicom_fhir_conversion
activities.description:
The conversion notebook activity will then convert the metadata to the FHIR presentation of ImagingStudy in ndjson format.
Please note that there should not be more than one instance of this notebook running as this will cause inconsistent results.

activities.name: fhir_ndjson_bronze_ingestion
activities.description:
This notebook activity facilitates the ingestion of FHIR ndjson data into Delta tables within the bronze lakehouse.
Please note that there should not be more than one instance of this notebook running as this will cause inconsistent results.

activities.name: bronze_silver_flatten
activities.description:
This notebook activity transforms and flattens the data from the bronze lakehouse and ingests the data into the silver lakehouse.
Please note that there should not be more than one instance of this notebook running as this will cause inconsistent results.
